title: The Legacy of Hungarian Political Thought Today
grammar: Academic synthesis of cleft identification and causal governance
goal: I can synthesize the insights of Széchenyi, Eötvös, Polányi, and Bibó regarding modern democracy and civil society.
I can integrate diverse cleft patterns ('az nem más, mint', 'éppen az, ami', 'abban rejlik, hogy', 'abból adódóan') in scholarly essays.
I can discuss how 19th and 20th-century Hungarian ideas inform contemporary debates on Europe, institutions, and civic courage.
